subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the public gateway managed-image ReDoS fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411, or route this availability report through private security handling first?
rationale: The root cause and fix are narrow, but the affected path is a stable gateway parser for model-supplied media and can stall reply handling, so the handling route is a maintainer/security choice.
